notes: 2025 final strength of schedule, for season-over-season comparison.

metric_definitions.definition: ESPN's rank of schedule strength among FBS teams from the perspective of an average FBS team. Rank 1 is the toughest schedule.
metric_definitions.label: ESPN FPI SOS

metric_definitions.definition: The same metric restricted to a team's remaining games.
metric_definitions.label: ESPN FPI remaining SOS

metric_definitions.definition: TeamRankings' predictive Season SOS power rating; a higher rating is tougher.
metric_definitions.label: TeamRankings Season SOS
